title: רבה בר ברונא

paragraphs: Rabbah bar Beruna. Shabbat 110a. Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 3:3 gives Rava bar Bina in Rav’s name; perhaps this is he. Yuhasin mentions Rava bar Beruna alongside R’ Beruna, followed by “pupil of Rav.” Perhaps he means that Rav Beruna was Rav's pupil.
